scenarios.title: Inert author HTML
scenarios.procedure: Render script, iframe, style and event-handler HTML nodes.
scenarios.expected: No author code executes; raw nodes are escaped; W_HTML_INERT appears; no automatic request occurs.

scenarios.title: Payload terminator escaping
scenarios.procedure: Export source text containing </script>, quotes, ampersands and U+2028/U+2029, then open file://.
scenarios.expected: The payload is intact; no extra executable node appears; the intended control still works.

scenarios.title: Opaque preview isolation
scenarios.procedure: From an adversarial frame/test payload, attempt parent storage, filesystem and unregistered message commands.
scenarios.expected: Access is blocked; invalid messages close their port; only allowlisted validated DTOs are processed.

scenarios.title: Zero automatic network requests
scenarios.procedure: Intercept HTTP(S)/WebSocket/EventSource requests on load, all controls, legend toggles, selection and export.
scenarios.expected: Zero application-initiated external requests. Deliberately clicking an external link is tested separately.

scenarios.title: ZIP traversal and duplicate paths
scenarios.procedure: Open bundles with ../, percent-encoded traversal, absolute paths, symlinks, duplicate/case-colliding entries.
scenarios.expected: E_ASSET_PATH or E_BUNDLE before extraction; no user file is created/modified.

scenarios.title: ZIP expansion, CRC and hash failures
scenarios.procedure: Use a compressed bomb, forged sizes, bad CRC and mismatched manifest SHA-256.
scenarios.expected: Stream stops at the limit or integrity error; E_LIMIT/E_BUNDLE/E_HASH_MISMATCH; no partial artifact survives.

scenarios.title: Raster rejection
scenarios.procedure: Import SVG, GIF, APNG, animated WebP, malformed PNG and an over-pixel-limit raster.
scenarios.expected: E_ASSET_TYPE or E_LIMIT; no browser markup injection or source change.

scenarios.title: Resource and fuzz limits
scenarios.procedure: Run seeded malformed inputs and every named bound at limit and limit+1.
scenarios.expected: No unhandled crash/hang; oversized inputs produce E_LIMIT; exact-limit valid inputs remain eligible.

scenarios.title: Dependency boundaries
scenarios.procedure: Inspect compiled dependency graphs and bundles.
scenarios.expected: Core has no Node fs/DOM/network/storage; reader exports have no React/CodeMirror; no eval/Function or remote loader.

scenarios.title: Plain source fidelity
scenarios.procedure: Open and save untouched UTF-8 source with BOM, CRLF, tabs and non-BMP Unicode.
scenarios.expected: Identical source bytes; diagnostics offsets match original UTF-16 coordinates.

scenarios.title: Source bundle round trip
scenarios.procedure: Pack local-image.tinta with its asset and unpack into a new directory.
scenarios.expected: Manifest/schema/hash valid; canonical source and original raster bytes survive; original input remains unchanged.

scenarios.title: Atomic overwrite rejection
scenarios.procedure: Build into an existing file without --force, then inject an IO failure during authorized replacement.
scenarios.expected: E_OUTPUT_EXISTS or E_IO; pre-existing bytes remain recoverable/intact; no truncated success artifact.

scenarios.title: Snapshot identity
scenarios.procedure: Apply a valid answers snapshot, then change one source byte and reuse it.
scenarios.expected: First snapshot works; second produces E_HASH_MISMATCH/E_SNAPSHOT and leaves state unchanged.

scenarios.title: Interactive initial/current answers
scenarios.procedure: Export article.tinta once with defaults and once with growth=10/period=2.
scenarios.expected: Defaults show 110; current answers show 121; Reset returns to each artifact baseline; source defaults remain 5/2.

scenarios.title: Static content minimization
scenarios.procedure: Export guide.tinta with platform=macOS and more_detail=false.
scenarios.expected: No script/program/source/Windows/Linux hidden branch text; visible macOS content remains; controls become labelled static values.

scenarios.title: Static and interactive hidden assets
scenarios.procedure: Place an unresolved image in a false branch and export both formats.
scenarios.expected: Static succeeds without the unused asset; interactive is blocked until it is supplied.

scenarios.title: Presentation is not an answer snapshot
scenarios.procedure: Hide a legend series, pin a datum and open details before exporting current answers.
scenarios.expected: Both artifacts include all series; interactive details start closed; static details are expanded; answer values are retained.

scenarios.title: No-script fallback
scenarios.procedure: Open an interactive export with JavaScript disabled.
scenarios.expected: One static selected-answer document is readable with the explicit no-script sentence; no duplicated document when JS is enabled.

scenarios.title: Actual local-file browser opening
scenarios.procedure: Open generated artifacts with file:// in automated Chromium/Firefox/WebKit and manual Safari.
scenarios.expected: No server/module-CORS workaround; controls, charts and reset work in the actual local-file context.

scenarios.title: Markdown enrichment preserves original
scenarios.procedure: Open import-before.md, Enrich as Tinta, inspect the proposed two escapes and save separately.
scenarios.expected: Source Markdown file untouched; resulting content matches import-after.tinta; mode changes to Tinta.

scenarios.title: Invalid edit retains labelled preview
scenarios.procedure: Break an expression, interact with the stale preview, then fix it.
scenarios.expected: Stale banner visible; preview controls and exports disabled while invalid; source save stays available; fix resumes a current valid preview.

scenarios.title: Worker stale response and timeout
scenarios.procedure: Delay old compile response, send newer source, then simulate watchdog timeout.
scenarios.expected: Old result ignored; newer revision alone can render; timeout gives E_WORKER_TIMEOUT and preserves buffer/recovery.

scenarios.title: Answer reconciliation
scenarios.procedure: Edit prose, then change one slider initial/domain and remove another control.
scenarios.expected: Prose-only change retains compatible answers; changed/new controls reset as specified; removed control disappears; one reset notice.

scenarios.title: Cancelled file action
scenarios.procedure: With dirty source, choose Open/New, then Cancel; cancel an import and an export dialog.
scenarios.expected: Current source, assets, answers and focus stay unchanged; no write occurs.

scenarios.title: Cross-browser save fallback
scenarios.procedure: Test writable-file-handle close and input/download-only browsers.
scenarios.expected: Correct Saved vs Download started status; revoked permissions do not lose source; no requirement for showSaveFilePicker support.

scenarios.title: Automatic local drafts
scenarios.procedure: Edit with automatic drafts, reload a document URL, verify source and mode restoration, then disable, delete and deny/quota-limit storage.
scenarios.expected: Automatic source restoration never persists reader answers; opt-out survives reload; deletion works; unavailable storage warns without disabling source save.

scenarios.title: Source plus asset undo
scenarios.procedure: Insert a raster image, undo and redo with another reference to the same hash.
scenarios.expected: One undo step covers source/import; shared referenced bytes are not deleted; original disk image is untouched.

scenarios.title: Keyboard figure exploration
scenarios.procedure: For each type, use the range with arrows, Home/End/Page keys, then action buttons.
scenarios.expected: Point order matches prepared rows/series; values announced; same datum can be selected without a pointer.

scenarios.title: Shared selection
scenarios.procedure: Select a bar in report.tinta and a numeric point in article.tinta; change their explicit controls too.
scenarios.expected: One revision updates control, linked marks and narrative; no hover writes state; rejected selection rolls back all outputs.

scenarios.title: Selection outside filter
scenarios.procedure: Select Mon, then set minimum=150 in report.tinta.
scenarios.expected: Control remains Mon; chart has no Mon highlight and states selection is outside current figure; no automatic replacement.

scenarios.title: Legend-only visibility
scenarios.procedure: Toggle named series and pie categories, including all hidden and all-zero visible data.
scenarios.expected: Global totals/views unchanged; chart messages/totals follow visible entries; restoring legend restores geometry.

scenarios.title: Histogram conservation
scenarios.procedure: Run empty, constant, boundary and generated finite observations with 2..30 bins.
scenarios.expected: Sum of counts equals row count; last edge is inclusive; no duplicated/lost observation; no selection control is created.

scenarios.title: Scatter duplicates
scenarios.procedure: Use duplicate x and overlapping points with multiple series and a valid select slider.
scenarios.expected: No duplicate-x error; explorer/table reaches every point; selected state is x, not row object or y.

scenarios.title: Responsive layout and lifecycle
scenarios.procedure: Resize figures, change rows, unmount/remount 100 times.
scenarios.expected: No page-wide overflow; observers/listeners disposed; focus retained on active reader controls; no growing retained instance count.

scenarios.title: Document keyboard and focus
scenarios.procedure: Read all headings/lists, change controls, hide the focused control via a condition, reset.
scenarios.expected: Native behaviour; predictable fallback focus; one polite update, not a flood; hidden content absent from tab order.

scenarios.title: Assistive technology review
scenarios.procedure: Perform named VoiceOver/Safari and NVDA/Firefox scripts plus actual iOS reading.
scenarios.expected: Reviewer evidence covers names, roles, values, chart alternatives and errors; unavailable environments remain BLOCKED.

scenarios.title: Zoom, reflow and forced colours
scenarios.procedure: Review 320/390/768/1024/1440 widths, 200% text and 400% page zoom, forced colours.
scenarios.expected: Prose usable without horizontal scrolling; 2D exceptions contained; contrast/focus/selected-state visible without colour alone.

scenarios.title: Command usage matrix
scenarios.procedure: For each command test required/unknown/duplicate flags, Unicode paths, spaces, stdin and JSON mode.
scenarios.expected: Specified usage exit codes, no shell interpretation, one JSON envelope, no unexpected output writes.

scenarios.title: No publication surface
scenarios.procedure: Inspect command help, editor menus and network code.
scenarios.expected: No publish/upload/account/billing/AI/server-service command exists; studio prints/copies a local artifact only.

scenarios.title: Locked performance corpus
scenarios.procedure: Run the benchmark protocol on the required reference machine, warm and cold.
scenarios.expected: Timing/memory/bundle budgets met with environment and distributions recorded; no measurements borrowed from 0.2.

scenarios.title: Budget covers the whole revision
scenarios.procedure: Create many individually valid views/charts whose combined work exceeds the global counter.
scenarios.expected: One E_LIMIT; transaction rejected; no per-chart counter reset permits bypass.

scenarios.title: Toolchain provenance and exact pins
scenarios.procedure: Resolve permitted dependencies, freeze lock, typecheck contracts and smoke import Node/browser packages.
scenarios.expected: Exact versions/engines/peers/license inventory recorded; no floating committed install commands; no fake test pass.

scenarios.title: Release evidence honesty
scenarios.procedure: Review status/evidence, screenshots and browser reports before tagging.
scenarios.expected: No NOT_RUN/BLOCKED mandatory gate is presented as PASS; owner approves manual gates; no automatic publish/tag push.

scenarios.title: Schema preview and insertion
scenarios.procedure: Import CSV with commas/newlines/leading zeros and JSON with reordered keys; cancel and then accept.
scenarios.expected: Deterministic full-column types/mapping; exact preview; one root @data insertion; cancel has no effect; no live data link.

scenarios.title: CommonMark and dialect corpus
scenarios.procedure: Run every pinned CommonMark 0.31.2 example and supported extension fixtures. Include conventional #heading links, duplicate slugs, prefixed-ID collisions and a target hidden by a condition.
scenarios.expected: Parse equivalence for all; safe-render deviations documented only for deliberate HTML/URL policy, no skipped parsing examples. Heading fragments resolve through the specified alias map without source rewrites or changing answers.

scenarios.title: Lossless source spans and contexts
scenarios.procedure: Use CRLF, BOM, astral text, escaped braces, code fences with @end and nested Markdown inside conditions.
scenarios.expected: Correct original UTF-16 spans and boundaries; source import/edit does not reformat unaffected prose.
